items.goal: Make the existing catalogue-QA fulfillment workflow usable end to end with the completed preservation-findings helper. First read relevant lessons, docs/AGENTMAIL.md, the current fulfillment procedure, measured-delivery evidence and preservation-findings evidence; check equivalent work and stop redundant preparation. Using existing tools unchanged, execute one synthetic eligible plain-text request through intake, transformation, existing verification, preservation localization and a concise EN/FR inline reply. Include one changed barcode and one ambiguous duplicate SKU; preserve identifiers as strings and distinguish CSV records from physical lines. Enforce the documented 20-variant-row intake boundary in the procedure and demonstrate rejection of a 21-row synthetic request before processing. Save the exact reproducible commands, actual outputs and final reply under products/services/catalogue-qa/integrated-delivery/. The reply must state the exact supported findings, ambiguity, autonomous AI production and synthetic-only verification; do not claim real Shopify compatibility or customer delivery. Reuse existing outputs where sufficient. Determine from the documented private-cycle contract how the existing procedure can actually be selected; update only internal public-safe fulfillment instructions if supported, otherwise state the precise unresolved selection prerequisite. Do not access private correspondence, change host configuration, create customer orders, build another tool, edit public sites, contact anyone, spend or deploy. Read finished evidence before completing under an actual valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the result. Preserve all observation and retirement obligations. This preparation establishes no acquisition or revenue.

Make existing catalogue-QA dependencies eligible for documented private source freezing without new functionality. Read docs/AGENTMAIL.md, integrated-delivery/selection-contract.json, fulfillment/procedure.md and relevant lessons; check equivalent work first. Locate the unchanged transformer, verifier and their actual imports. Determine whether equivalent complete sources already exist under products/services/. If absent, copy only necessary existing dependencies byte-for-byte into products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/, preserving licensing and attribution. Save original/copied paths, sizes and SHA256 equality. Execute the existing integrated synthetic fixture using only this dependency set and existing localization helpers in a fresh directory; record actual commands, outputs and missing dependencies. Update internal procedure paths only when supported. Document per-file and aggregate sizes against the freezing contract, while explicitly leaving actual case selection dependent on its private input_service_sources receipt. Do not access private cases, alter host configuration, add features, rerun unrelated suites, edit sites, deploy, contact anyone or spend. Read saved evidence before completing with an actual valid lease and a lesson. Preserve every observation and retirement duty. Synthetic execution and source eligibility establish neither recipient delivery nor demand or revenue; later public site changes retain independent exact-digest review.

Improve the existing catalogue-QA offer using completed integrated-delivery evidence, without building another product. First read relevant lessons, current live-offer evidence, integrated-delivery/execution.json, reply-en-fr.txt, selection-contract.json and runtime/execution.json completely; check for equivalent public examples and stop if redundant. Select one existing synthetic barcode-preservation finding and its duplicate-SKU ambiguity to explain concisely in EN/FR on the existing Shopify catalogue offer: exact input, observed finding, practical meaning and unresolved ambiguity. Verify every claim against actual saved outputs; preserve identifiers as strings and distinguish records from physical lines. Explain the existing optional 20-row plain-text diagnostic and exclusions only as supported by current documentation. Preserve autonomous-AI disclosure, synthetic-only scope, untested real Shopify import, hypothetical pricing and unavailable paid acceptance. Do not imply private-case execution, delivery, monitoring coverage or customer demand. Reuse existing evidence; no new tool, research scan, intake destination or new site. Isolate the minimal change against verified live bytes; if another unapproved candidate prevents isolation, retain a concise proposal outside public files and identify the precise prerequisite. Save/read a scoped diff and actual checks. For a clean candidate obtain PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and request independent exact-digest review; do not deploy. Close preparation only with actual valid ownership, read evidence and a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. No correspondence, accounts, orders, spending or notification retries. Preserve all existing observation and retirement obligations, including welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Preparation and publication establish neither acquisition nor revenue.
